bug_semantics: IndexFile.remove() and Head.checkout() forward caller **kwargs into `git rm` and `git checkout` with no allow_unsafe_options/check_unsafe_options gate. GitPython's transform_kwargs/dashify turns pathspec_from_file=<path> and pathspec_file_nul=True into --pathspec-from-file=<path> --pathspec-file-nul, placed before any `--` pathspec separator. Git then treats the named file as one NUL-delimited pathspec and quotes the entire unmatched pathspec in its error; GitPython returns that text on GitCommandError.stderr, disclosing any process-readable file whose contents do not match a tracked path. Same primitive as TagReference.create() -F in GHSA-3f7w-8rr8-f37f, at two sites that advisory's sweep assessed as non-disclosing.
flaw_origin: The vulnerable mechanism is unguarded high-level kwargs forwarding into git commands that later grew --pathspec-from-file. It was first written on 2009-10-23 in 0cd09bd306486028f5442c56ef2e947355a06282, which replaced a NotImplementedError stub with `self.repo.git.rm(args, paths, **kwargs)` against an already-live Git._call_process/transform_kwargs that dashifies arbitrary kwargs into CLI options and raises GitCommandError with stderr. Head.checkout() repeated the same unguarded `self.repo.git.checkout(self, **kwargs)` twelve days later in ace1fed6321bb8dd6d38b2f58d7cf815fa16db7a. Subsequent tab-to-space, package moves, black, and typing commits only relocated or restyled those lines. The 2022 check_unsafe_options framework (e6108c7997f5c8f7361b982959518e982b973230) and 2026 GHSA-3f7w-8rr8-f37f guard (3af0c2516c5e18c829da30338614688f6b69b49c) never enrolled these two sinks.

First implemented IndexFile.remove in lib/git/index.py as `removed_paths = self.repo.git.rm(args, paths, **kwargs).splitlines()` (then ~line 707), documenting kwargs as passed to git-rm.

Parent 13a26d4f9c22695033040dfcd8c76fd94187035b has no git.rm anywhere (`git grep git.rm` empty). Parent lib/git/index.py:582-601 is only the a7a4388eeaa4b6b94192dce67257a34c4a6cbd26 stub `def remove(... **kwargs): raise NotImplementedError('todo')` with no git invocation. Vulnerable git.rm(**kwargs) line is absent at the immediate parent.

At the BIC, lib/git/cmd.py already converted kwargs to CLI options: dashify replaces '_' with '-'; transform_kwargs emits `--pathspec-from-file=<v>` / `--pathspec-file-nul` for non-bool/True values; _call_process concatenates opt_args before positional args, so kwargs land before remove()'s `--`. GitCommandError.__init__(command, status, stderr=None) stored self.stderr (lib/git/errors.py:20-31), matching the in-band disclosure path.

Parent f1e9df152219e85798d78284beeda88f6baa9ec7 has no `def checkout` on Head. Same mechanism, later instance; not the BIC.

Direct fix f2550b65bf60ca087190981e2c7b6865e201f40c ('Guard pathspec file inputs in high-level commands', 2026-08-04) adds Git.unsafe_git_pathspec_from_file_options=['--pathspec-from-file'] and check_unsafe_options at IndexFile.remove, Head.checkout, and HEAD.reset, with allow_unsafe_options opt-in. Landed on main via merge 9a8f6fef579912bc8b10ab513c33ca6ea1f687ef (PR #2204). Git 2.25.0 introduced --pathspec-from-file; GitPython had forwarded arbitrary kwargs since 2009.

Later guards did not introduce these lines: e6108c7997f5c8f7361b982959518e982b973230 (2022-12-23) added check_unsafe_options only for clone/fetch/pull/push (cmd.py/remote.py/repo/base.py). 3af0c2516c5e18c829da30338614688f6b69b49c (GHSA-3f7w-8rr8-f37f) guarded IndexFile.checkout/TagReference.create only; it did not touch Head.checkout or IndexFile.remove.

reasoning: CVE-2026-76217 / GHSA-w672-239g-c3gr is a real, published CWE-73: GitPython high-level rm and checkout wrappers forwarded caller kwargs into git without an unsafe-option denylist, so --pathspec-from-file plus --pathspec-file-nul made git quote a caller-chosen file's full contents in the unmatched-pathspec error that GitPython surfaces as GitCommandError.stderr. Vendor GHSA-hh9p-6wh2-4mfc names IndexFile.remove and Head.checkout, gives a working PoC on 3.1.57, and is patched in 3.1.58; CVE.org is PUBLISHED (not withdrawn/rejected), so this is not FALSE_POSITIVE. The smallest first-write of the flawed mechanism is 0cd09bd306486028f5442c56ef2e947355a06282, which implemented git.rm(**kwargs) on a live transform_kwargs path; the parent only had a NotImplementedError stub with no git.rm. Head.checkout's unguarded git.checkout(**kwargs) arrived later in ace1fed6321bb8dd6d38b2f58d7cf815fa16db7a as a second site of the same pattern. Whitespace, moves, and typing commits are not BICs. The 2022/2026 option-guard work never wrote these sinks and is not inverted into an introducer. The BIC commit object is human (Sebastian Thiel, 2009) with no AI authorship/co-authorship markers, so the verdict is NOT_AI. The content fix is f2550b65bf60ca087190981e2c7b6865e201f40c, which first applies check_unsafe_options(--pathspec-from-file) at both disclosed sites and lands in 3.1.58 via 9a8f6fef579912bc8b10ab513c33ca6ea1f687ef.
